description: Screen 1 - Dashboard (Home). Rebuild app/dashboard to show the household at a glance: a large circular Trust Score gauge at 87/100 with a 'Protected' label and upward trend, four Threat-Summary cards with count-up animation, a scrollable color-coded Recent Activity feed, and three Quick-Action buttons. Depends on FEAT-001 (mock data, CircularGauge, AnimatedCounter).
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001's findings first. Rebuild app/dashboard/page.tsx keeping it a server component that owns metadata and wraps content in <AppShell>; move any client-only interactivity into app/dashboard/DashboardClient.tsx ('use client').
Add the large circular Trust Score gauge at 87/100 using components/CircularGauge.tsx, with a 'Protected' label and a subtle upward trend arrow (lucide TrendingUp).

Add a Threat Summary bar: four cards reading '23 Threats Blocked This Week', '156 Devices Scanned', '0 Active Risks', '4 Family Members Protected', using AnimatedCounter so the numbers count up on view. Reuse StatCard/Card where it fits.

Add a scrollable Recent Activity feed from data/mock.ts recentActivity, each row with a color-coded severity dot (red/amber/green), a brief description with the domain/source, and a relative timestamp. Cover the spec examples: phishing blocked (fake-bank-login.com, 2 min ago), suspicious IoT camera upload (1 hr ago), weekly scan complete (3 hrs ago), scam call intercepted (Yesterday), new device connected (Yesterday).

Add three Quick-Action buttons: 'Run Security Scan', 'Check a Link', 'View Family Report'. 'Run Security Scan' triggers a short simulated scanning animation (setTimeout in the client component with cleanup); 'View Family Report' links to /family-protection; 'Check a Link' can open a small simulated inline result. Keep hover effects.
Run 'npm run build' and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard renders a circular gauge showing 87 with a 'Protected' label and an upward trend indicator.
Four summary cards show 23 / 156 / 0 / 4 and animate (count up) on load.
A scrollable recent-activity feed shows color-coded entries with timestamps including the phishing fake-bank-login.com example.
Three quick-action buttons are present and 'Run Security Scan' plays a simulated animation.
verification: Run 'npm run build'; confirm exit 0 with no errors.
Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000/dashboard, confirm the gauge, four counting cards, activity feed, and three actions render and 'Run Security Scan' animates with no console errors.
findings:
DONE. Rebuilt the Dashboard (Screen 1). app/dashboard/page.tsx is a server component that owns metadata and wraps <AppShell> + <PageHeader> (titled 'Johnson Family · Home', Denver CO), then renders app/dashboard/DashboardClient.tsx ('use client') with mock exports passed as props (trustScore, trustScoreLabel, dashboardStats, recentActivity).

LAYOUT (DashboardClient): top row = TrustScoreCard (left) + 2x2 summary cards (right, lg:col-span-2); bottom row = Recent Activity feed (lg:col-span-2) + Quick Actions.
- Trust Score: CircularGauge value=87 label='Protected' size=200 (uses scoreTone -> emerald since >=85). Upward trend pill with lucide TrendingUp reads 'Up 4 points this month' (trustScore.trend==='up', change=4).
- Summary cards: four cards from dashboardStats. Values are stored as strings in mock ('23','156','0','4'), so SummaryCard parses the numeric part and feeds AnimatedCounter (count-up on view, startOnView default). Tone colors via STAT_TONE map (safe/warning/threat/accent). NOTE: AnimatedCounter renders 0 on first paint (hydration-safe) then animates, so SSR HTML shows the label text; the number is injected client-side.
- Recent Activity: scrollable (max-h-80 overflow-y-auto) list over recentActivity; color-coded dot via DOT_CLASS (red->bg-threat, amber->bg-amber, green->bg-emerald), title + source (domain/number) + relativeLabel. Covers all five spec events incl. phishing fake-bank-login.com '2 min ago'.
- Quick Actions: three buttons. 'Run Security Scan' -> simulated scan via setTimeout (2.6s) with Loader2 spinner + animate-pulse-slow progress bar, then CheckCircle2 'Scan complete' that auto-clears after 4s; all timers in useRef, cleared in a useEffect cleanup on unmount. 'Check a Link' -> 1.8s simulated inline 'No threats found' result. 'View Family Report' -> Link to /family-protection. Hover effects on all.

ICONS used from lucide-react: LayoutDashboard, TrendingUp, ShieldCheck, ScanLine, Link2, Users, Loader2, CheckCircle2.

VERIFICATION: $env:Path prefix needed for node (see FEAT-001). 'npm run build' exits 0, all 10 routes compile (/dashboard 5.22 kB). The long-running 'npm run dev' is blocked by the agent harness when run in the foreground; worked around by launching it detached via Start-Process with log redirection, polling http://localhost:3000/dashboard until 200, then stopping the node process. Confirmed: GET /dashboard -> 200, and the returned HTML contains 'Family Trust Score', 'Protected', 'Recent activity', 'Run Security Scan', 'Quick actions', 'fake-bank-login.com', and the gauge value 87. Note: Invoke-WebRequest stdout is swallowed by this harness, so results were written to a temp file and read back (temp files cleaned up afterward); dev log also showed '✓ Compiled /dashboard' and 'GET /dashboard 200'.

CLEANUP for later FEATs: the old dashboard imported StatCard/ThreatRow/ProgressBar and the legacy threats[] slice; those are no longer used by /dashboard but remain used elsewhere, so nothing was removed.
